stories.title: Fifa to miss equal Women’s World Cup prize money ambition set by Infantino
summary: Infantino said in 2023 equality was Fifa’s targetPrize money could double but big gap will remainFifa is to fall short of gender equality with the prize money on offer at next year’s Women’s World Cup, despite making a record $15bn (£11.2bn) in revenue from this summer’s men’s tournament.Gianni Infantino, the Fifa president, said in 2023 that the organisation’s ambitionwas to have equality for the prize pot for 2027, saying: “Fifa is stepping up with actions, not just with words.” There had, therefore, been widespread hope across the women’s game that 2027’s prize pot would match the men’s on at least a per-team basis.
